_comment: The living reserve: a world on a stream that its viewers act on (`ReserveSession`). `offered` are the powers the reserve's world has (`powers.json`). Viewers write commands in the chat; `commands` maps each word, after «!», to what it does. Times are simulated seconds. `cooldowns` are per viewer: a ward (`adopt`), a steward's power (`power`), joining a fund (`team`). `vote`: every `every_seconds` a vote of `choices` events from `events`, open for `open_seconds`; viewers vote with «!1», «!2»... (or «!голос 2»), the most votes winning, the first on a tie. `teams`: viewers back a species' fund with «!олени» and the like; every `every_seconds` each fund counts its members active in that time, and the fund with most - at least `min_members` - has its `perk` carried out. `names` keeps wards' names to letters, spaces and hyphens, at most `max_length`, with none of `blocked` in them. `link` is the local port the chat bridge sends lines of JSON to (`tools/stream_bridge`). `selection` are the setup options of the reserve's world over the defaults, `seed` its seed (0 for a new one each time). The reserve saves every `autosave_seconds` to its own slots and goes on from the newest when started again. `director` paces the camera, in real seconds: a shot of what happened lasts `shot_seconds`, one a viewer asked for («!моё») `asked_seconds`, and what happened is worth a shot for `moment_seconds`. `rescue` keeps the reserve from losing a species for good: every `every_seconds` a species the world began with that is down to fewer than its `below` gets newcomers from the edge (`immigrate`), no sooner than `gap_seconds` after its last. The viewers dig no more than `steward.max_ponds` ponds and cull no foxes while fewer than `steward.cull_floor` are left; newcomers by a vote or a fund's perk do not come to a species already at its `ceilings`. `powers` changes the settings of the reserve's powers (`powers.json`), here a cull's cooldown, many viewers sharing it. The reserve remembers its `viewers_kept` most recently seen viewers and, in its story (names and family trees), `story_animals` animals, the longest dead forgotten first.
